summary: GoldMining Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing an updated preliminary economic assessment (PEA) for its La Mina Project in Colombia. The PEA reports an after-tax NPV of $1.0 billion and 32.2% IRR at base case prices. This is a project update disclosure, not a special situation event; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
